stories.why_moved: The introduction of a $15 billion liquidity facility by the central bank directly aims to counteract heavy selling pressure and restore capital inflows to the onshore stock market.

stories.headline: Morgan Stanley Strategist Says US Midterm Election Is Market 'Clearing Event'
stories.summary: Morgan Stanley chief stock-market strategist Mike Wilson stated that the U.S. midterm elections represent a classic clearing event whose outcome will be good news for markets regardless of the result.
stories.why: Morgan Stanley is a major global investment bank. Market commentary from its chief equity strategists is widely monitored by institutional investors for asset allocation guidance.
